opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Bilal Khan vs State Of Uttarakhand on 16 April, 2024
Author: Ravindra Maithani Bench: Ravindra Maithani HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL  Anticipatory Bail Application No.332 of 2024 Bilal Khan ........Applicant  Versus State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent Present:-
 Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the applicant appeared  through video conferencing.
Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat and Devender Singh, AGA for the  State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
opennyai_summary.decision:
Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.353 of 2022 dated 04.07.2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120-B IPC, Police Station Jhabreda, District Haridwar.
It is argued that the co-accused having similar role have already been granted ad interim anticipatory bail by this Court.
4. Let State file objections within four weeks.
Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iii) He shall deposit his passport with the concerned court.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the concerned court.
(iv) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i) & (ii) above.
